+---
+## What
+Task 01M2JFQ6YZ3FM3G0CY3040SMDS has this line: "CodeContext does not use Ranker's selection tier (`Searcher`, `SelectionTier`, `AgentSession`). Thus CodeContext takes no LLM input. Do not add one." The user's quote in the same task says the opposite: "we need to pass ranker an LLM and an Embedder". The line is false.
+
+## Steps
+- [ ] Add a comment to task 01M2JFQ6YZ3FM3G0CY3040SMDS. It says that the "Do not add one" line is wrong, and names the task that adds the model.
+- [ ] Add a section to `ARCHITECTURE.md` about retrieval: the three layers (tree-sitter, LSP, search), the three signals, the Ranker fusion, and the required selection model supplied by the host. Say that the host picks the model, like FoundationModelsMultitool.
+- [ ] Search the repo for other text that says CodeContext has no LLM input. Fix each one.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `grep -rn "takes no LLM input" .kanban Sources ARCHITECTURE.md` gives no output.
+- [ ] `ARCHITECTURE.md` describes the selection model as required.
+
+## Notes
+Do this after the selection-model task, so the text matches the code. #docs
\ No newline at end of file
